What if you sat on the toilet and pooped out a whole watermelon?
Most people think the only problem is squeezing it out.
But a watermelon would never make it that far.
Your food pipe is only as wide as a coin, so you'd have to eat it in bites.
Then your stomach squishes every bite into mush, finer than a grain of rice.
Watermelon is mostly water, so your gut soaks it up into your blood.
The sugar becomes fuel for your muscles.
Only the tough fibre and a few seeds keep sliding along.
So you can eat a whole watermelon, but what comes out is just a normal poop.
And a whole lot of pee.
